# Debian Build and Package

## Prerequisites

Install the development packages needed by the build:

```bash
sudo apt install pkg-config libvulkan-dev libx11-dev libxext-dev libxrandr-dev libxrender-dev libxfixes-dev libxcursor-dev libxi-dev libxss-dev libxkbcommon-dev libxkbcommon-x11-dev libwayland-dev wayland-protocols libegl1-mesa-dev libgl1-mesa-dev
```

## CMake

Install CMake

```bash
sudo apt install cmake
```

## AppImageTool

Install the AppImageTool
```bash
wget https://github.com/AppImage/appimagetool/releases/download/continuous/appimagetool-x86_64.AppImage

chmod +x appimagetool-x86_64.AppImage

sudo mv appimagetool-x86_64.AppImage /usr/local/bin/appimagetool
```


## Build and Create the .Appimage

1. Clone the repository:

```bash
git clone --recursive https://github.com/Engineer162/MTCAD.git
cd MTCAD
```

2. Configure, build, and package for Debian:

```bash
cmake -S . -B build
cmake --build build --config Release
cmake --build build --target appimage --config Release
```

The generated `.Appimage` is written to the `dist/` directory (for example `dist/mtcad-0.3.0-x86_64.AppImage`).

## Run

Run it with:
```bash
chmod +x mtcad-0.3.0-x86_64.AppImage

./mtcad-0.3.0-x86_64.AppImage
```

## Notes

-  AppImage may not correctly work on NixOS
